name: order_csf_culture
description: Orders a cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) culture obtained via lumbar puncture. Identifies bacterial, viral, and fungal pathogens causing meningitis or encephalitis. Includes Gram stain and antibiotic sensitivity testing.

clinical_indication.description: Clinical reason for ordering CSF culture

include_viral_pcr.description: Whether to include viral PCR panel (HSV, enterovirus, etc.)

include_fungal.description: Whether to include fungal culture and cryptococcal antigen

include_afb.description: Whether to include AFB culture for TB meningitis

when_to_use: Fever with altered mental status and neck stiffness

examples.query: Send CSF for culture and viral PCR

args.clinical_indication: acute meningitis with fever, headache, and nuchal rigidity
